selection.summary: Bug report on NodeBB v4.4.3 notifications dropdown and category selector dropup issues. Evidence: fork-topic.tpl (h1, h14) and move-topic.tpl (h2, h15) both import partials/category/selector-dropdown-right.tpl, whose template (h4) applies the dropup class causing misplaced/erratic dropdown placement in modals. Notifications async loading flow is in public/src/client/header/notifications.js (h3, h23, h24) where requireAndCall('loadNotifications') on dropdown toggle can race/miss refresh, with the loader implemented in public/src/modules/notifications.js. Related selector dropdown markup is in h0 (selector-dropdown-content.tpl), and dropdown behavior consumers h9/h10/h12 (categoryFilter.js, categorySearch.js, threadTools.js) confirm dropup/dropdown class handling affects fork/move modal category selectors.
